fields.description: Three waterfront towers at Dubai Harbour bring together branded apartments, duplexes and penthouses. Shared leisure spaces occupy a connecting podium, with the marina and waterfront dining close by.

overview: Arada’s February 2026 construction announcement describes 490 residences across three towers. Its earlier launch material described more than 400; neither figure represents current unsold stock.
The residential range includes single-level apartments, duplexes and five-bedroom penthouses. Private pools and additional private facilities belong to selected layouts, rather than every home.
research.locationNote: Dubai Harbour, overlooking Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah and Bluewaters; views depend on the residence.
research.priceNote: The historical developer flyer advertised AED 3.8 million. Property Finder records a separate AED 4.27 million launch guide. Neither establishes today’s available unit or price.
research.paymentNote: The current Tower 3 page gives 10% down, 50% in instalments over three years and 40% on completion. Property Finder matches the aggregate split. Request the dated unit-specific schedule and applicable fees.
research.handoverNote: Arada’s October 2024 launch targeted 2027; Property Finder now lists December 2028. The February 2026 contract announcement confirms early works but provides no revised delivery date, so a single confirmed handover is not shown.

facts.label: Construction milestone
facts.value: Arada announced an AED 1.55 billion main contract with ECC on 23 February 2026; excavation and piling were already underway.

facts.label: Brand and development roles
facts.value: The developer states that Arada and EGR license the W marks; Marriott does not own, develop or sell these residences.
